name: cloud-shader
description: Soft procedural clouds that drift across a sky. Tune speed, count, and colors, then draw any content above the field.
purpose: Gives a landing page or hero a living sky without shipping image assets, while leaving the offer and chrome to the consumer.
avoidFor: pages that cannot afford a WebGL backdrop
